description: Read-only reference values for the legacy-parity regression test. These are derived numbers only: peak heights recovered from archived figures by numerical inversion, and the values this package computes for the same parameters. No original file, figure or measurement is reproduced or redistributed here.

units.peaks: probability mass per grid point, on a 0.5 dB grid of 51 points spanning -85 to -60 dBm

one_attack.status: parameters recovered; reproduced by this package to within 1.2e-7

recovered_parameters.note: The archived filename claimed the tampered access point reported -99 dBm. Solving for the parameters that reproduce all four curve peaks gives -90 dBm instead, so the filename and the contents disagree.

sign_error.note: The third pairwise product of e_2 was evaluated with the observation un-negated while its mean stayed negative, so that term was about 8e-39 instead of about 7e-4 and dropped out. The archived m1 peak of 0.0305445 matches the buggy expression, not the mathematics.

unrecovered.status: parameters never recorded and not recoverable from the surviving code; kept as provenance only and NOT asserted by any test
unrecovered.note: A parameter search over plausible access point counts, observations and standard deviations reached these values no closer than about 7e-3, against 1.2e-7 for the one-attack case. Without a run manifest these figures cannot be regenerated, which is the gap symloc.io_.write_manifest exists to close.

truncation_artefact.note: With the parameters left in the surviving script the attacked naive-Bayes curve peaks ABOVE the unattacked control. Nothing about the attack improved the fix; the attacked access point simply lost more mass off the grid edge, so dividing by a smaller total raised what remained.
